name: literature-review
description: Build transparent, evidence-grounded non-systematic literature reviews without claiming systematic coverage.

interface.longDescription: A method-aware workflow for narrative, integrative, critical, conceptual, and state-of-the-art reviews. It records search and selection decisions, verifies source evidence, builds concept-centric synthesis, tests counterevidence, and reports coverage limits without claiming systematic-review or PRISMA compliance.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan a transparent narrative literature review.
Build an integrative review with a concept matrix.
Check whether my review request belongs in a systematic-review workflow.
